latest_release.body:
# ArkOS4Clone 20261124 Release Notes

## Changes compared to the previous version

There are too many changes to bother with an OTA update, so if you're interested, please reflash the system. If not, you can continue using the previous version.

Since this release introduces the 5.10 kernel, it has not been fully tested. Vulkan is only available with the 5.10 kernel.

There are simply too many test combinations to cover: 4 screen rotation angles, 2 system versions, and 2 kernel versions. Testing every combination would require an unreasonable amount of work.

So, for now, this is what it is. I've only performed partial testing on the R46H.

### Changelog

1. Added dual-kernel support, allowing users to switch between Linux 4.4.189 and 5.10.252.
2. Added more compression algorithms for ZRAM.
3. Added Vulkan support for PPSSPP, PPSSPP 2021, Flycast, and Flycast 2022 on the 5.10 kernel.
4. Updated ScummVM to v2026.4.0.
5. Added support for Yaba Sanshiro Pirry v1.6.3.
6. Added the Yabadabadoo core.
7. Updated DSperate.
8. Added support for two additional clone handheld devices.
9. Added the MakeCode, ARMN64, and ARMGBA cores.
10. Added support for the ZT9101 USB Wi-Fi adapter.
11. Added an online multiplayer platform and synchronized with the RK3562 dArkOS build.
12. Updated RetroArch to the 2026.11 version.
13. Updated PPSSPP to the 2026.11 version. EBOOT.PBP installation is now supported. Place the file in `/roms/bios`.
14. Updated Hypseus Singe with SDL3 support.
15. Updated SDL2 and SDL3 with Vulkan support.

This release may introduce regressions, or it may not. If you encounter any issues, please submit an issue on GitHub.

Special thanks to **jokubasver, Takamaki069, whmzsu, and cliobrando** for their contributions.

# (d)ArkOS 4.4 Kernel Porting for Unsupported Devices

Bringing **(d)ArkOS 4.4 kernel** porting to unsupported devices. Contributions via PRs are always welcome.

> 💡 Use the [DTB Analysis Tool](https://lcdyk0517.github.io/dtbTools.html) to identify your clone type or request support for unsupported devices.

> 🔧 Use the [DTB Customization Tool](https://lcdyk0517.github.io/tools/dtb-tools.html) to customize your device settings, including joystick axis remapping, button mapping, battery capacity, and screen refresh rate.

> ⚠️ Please make sure to read the [Wiki](https://github.com/lcdyk0517/arkos4clone/wiki) thoroughly before use.

> 📝 **[View Changelog](Changelog.md)**

---

## Collaborators

- [@jokubasver](https://github.com/jokubasver) — mainly maintains support for **kernel 5.10.252**.
